items.key: ai:i'm a top recruiter: this is why australians can't find work - and it's about to get even worse: 'too much immigration too quickly'
items.text: I'm a top recruiter: This is why Australians can't find work - and it's about to get even worse: 'Too much immigration too quickly'
items.article: A top recruiter has issued a warning to Australians. Published: 04:16, 1 October 2026 | Updated: 04:36, 1 October 2026 Australians are facing a 'dismal' job market, with fierce competition as a result of immigration, an overreliance on university degrees and a lack of vacancies, a recruitment expert warns. According to the latest Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) data, the unemployment rate rose from 4.5 per cent in July to 4.6 per cent in August, the highest level recorded since the Covid pandemic. The number of unemployed Australians also increased by 28,200 to 722,900 over the same period. Top recruiter Tammie Ballis, who runs Realistic Careers in Sydney, said she believed that 'too much immigration too quickly' contributed to the influx of applicants chasing the same roles. 'We have seen too many people enter the job market in a short amount of time, and it is unfair to both immigrants and Australians,' she told the Daily Mail on Thursday.
